text: Still waiting for @116245 @ArgosHelpers to explain why when I tried to take something back today (without receipt, although it did have an Argos sticker on the front), why I was told I needed to prove the item had actually, in fact been purchased. Implying I'd stolen it.
@260944 Hi, I’m sorry you’ve received no previous reply but we have no messages from you prior to this one. We do request proof of purchase, even if the item’s labelled for a number of reasons: ...

@260944 ...Were a refund to be issued or an alternative item offered of about the same price, without the confirming info, we wouldn’t know how much was paid originally. Also, items have a 30 day money back guarantee and a 12 month guarantee...

@260944 ...and we’d need to know if the item’s still within one or other of those so we know what options we can offer to resolve the matter (over 30 days, we wouldn’t normally do a refund. If it’s older than 12 months, it'd be outside this)...

@260944 ...Whilst I appreciate your understandable frustration with this, whether there is a label on or not, it does confirm that the item was purchased from us & isn’t from a 3rd party or 2nd hand. Please note that they guarantee on our items...

@260944 ...is with the original purchaser only and the receipt confirms this. We can also accept a credit/debit card statement instead of the receipt if the item was purchased that way &, if not, as long as the customer can recall enough details...

@260944 ... for us to be able to locate and tie a specific transaction to them, we can email an e-receipt to them to use as proof. If you can recall these details and DM them over to us (date, store, cat no at least), I’m happy to see if we...
@260944 ... can locate the purchase transaction. - Drew
